channel.title: The Christian Post - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Christian Post (christianpost.com)

item.title: Ohio women sue UMC entities, claim they failed to properly respond to grooming, sexual abuse
item.description: Two women have filed a complaint against multiple United Methodist Church entities, alleging that they failed to appropriately respond to abuse that they experienced from a former church music director. #UnitedMethodistChurch #abuse #lawsuit #WestOhio #conference #UMC

item.title: Francis Collins wins prestigious Public Welfare Medal from National Academy of Sciences
item.description: Former National Institutes of Health Director Francis Collins and Evangelical geneticist Francis Collins has won the 2026 National Academy of Sciences Public Welfare Medal. #FrancisCollins #NationalAcademyofSciences #PublicWelfareMedal

item.title: First Baptist Dallas Pastor Robert Jeffress 'honored' by inclusion in 'Melania' film
item.description: Pastor Robert Jeffress of First Baptist Dallas is accustomed to being up on stage. On the big screen, however, is another matter entirely. #MelaniaTrump #RobertJeffress #PresidentDonaldTrump

item.title: Church gets nearly $1M grant to honor people sold at former slave market
item.description: A church in Tennessee has secured a $996,000 grant to build a memorial in remembrance of enslaved people at the site of a former slave market near their sanctuary. #BlackHistoryMonth #Tennessee #EpiscopalChurch #slavemarket #NathanBedfordForrest #Antebellum #history

item.title: Dennis Quaid and Milo Ventimiglia say 'I Can Only Imagine 2' shows faith in middle of suffering
item.description: Nine years after the original film turned a chart-topping worship song into a box-office phenomenon, “I Can Only Imagine 2” returns with a more complicated question: What happens after redemption? #ICanOnlyImagine2 #BartMillard #MiloVentimiglia #DennisQuaid

item.title: Trump claims he secured 2014 release of persecuted Christian Mariam Ibrahim: 'I did that'
item.description: President Donald Trump claimed during last week's National Prayer Breakfast that he made a phone call that secured the release of Mariam Ibrahim, a persecuted Sudanese Christian mother who was released during the Obama administration. #DonaldTrump #MariamIbrahim #Sudan #NationalPrayerBreakfast

item.title: Trump's Religious Liberty Commission sued by interfaith coalition alleging bias toward Christianity
item.description: An interfaith coalition has filed a lawsuit against the Trump administration over its Religious Liberty Commission, an entity within the U.S. Department of Justice, it contends, is unlawfully biased toward Christianity. #Interfaith #ReligiousLibertyCommission #MuseumoftheBible #Trump #churchandstate #religiousliberty

item.title: Oklahoma officials reject creation of first Jewish charter school; appeal expected
item.description: Oklahoma officials have rejected an application to create a Jewish charter school, citing a recent court decision against the creation of a virtual Catholic charter school. #BenGamla #charterschool #Oklahoma #Jewish #churchandstate #education

item.title: Al Mohler condemns Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear for using Bible to affirm LGBT ideology: 'stupid'
item.description: Theologian Al Mohler condemned Democratic Kentucky Gov. Andy Beshear's recent use of the Bible on "The View" to explain why he vetoed legislation prohibiting Medicaid from covering transgender surgeries and lifting his ban on so-called "conversion therapy." #AndyBeshear #AlMohler #Kentucky #TheView #abortion #transgender

item.title: In historic visit, Vance hails Armenia as 'bedrock of Christian civilization,' deletes reference to genocide
item.description: Vice President JD Vance hailed Armenia as a “bedrock of Christian civilization and culture” and later deleted a post referring to the Armenian genocide during a historic visit to the war-torn country amid ongoing tensions between one of the world's first national churches and Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan. #VPJDVance #Armenia #Genocide
